full_prompt_en: A square atmospheric image shows a sparse cluster of small red poppy-like flowers rising from a dark meadow into pale gray mist. The highest flower stands a little left of center on a long thin stem, its red petals forming a loose cup. Smaller red blooms and a few closed dark buds gather around it at varied heights, most concentrated in the left half. Tiny orange-red points continue across the lower middle distance, becoming less distinct as they recede. Near the right third, a dark slender tree trunk rises from the black foreground. Its thin branches spread into a soft vertical haze of gray, as if the upper crown has been drawn downward by motion or a long exposure. A second, much fainter upright silhouette stands far to the left. The upper left is nearly white with fog, while the right half passes through silver gray into charcoal around the blurred tree. The bottom quarter is almost black, with only faint grass strokes and stem lines escaping from it. No clear horizon, path, building, person, or sky feature establishes a precise place. The picture relies on color restraint: the red flowers remain the only conspicuous warm marks in a field of gray, black, and cool green. Edges vary deliberately. The nearest petals retain enough contour to be recognized, but grasses, distant blossoms, and trees dissolve into long vertical smears. The red heads float at eye level over a dark base, and their delicate stems seem vulnerable beneath the heavy soft mass of the trees. The overall mood is hushed and slightly uncanny, as if a familiar meadow were viewed through rain, fog, and motion at the same time.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形大气图像呈现稀疏的红色罂粟状小花，从深色草地伸进浅灰雾中。最高一朵位于中央稍左，顶着一根长而细的茎，红花瓣形成松开的杯形。较小的红花和几枚闭合深色花苞在不同高度围着它，主要聚在左半部。更细小的橙红光点横过中下方远处，越后退越难分辨。右侧约三分之一处，一根深暗纤细的树干从黑色前景升起，细枝向上扩成柔软竖向灰霾，像树冠被运动或长曝光向下拖曳。最左远处还有第二道更淡的直立剪影。左上几乎是白雾，右半从银灰逐渐走向模糊树旁的炭黑。下四分之一近乎纯黑，只有隐约草痕和花茎从中逃出。画面没有明确地平线、小径、建筑、人物或天空特征来确定地点。色彩非常节制：红花是在灰、黑、冷绿场域里唯一显眼的暖色。边缘刻意变化，近处花瓣仍有足够轮廓供辨认，草、远花和树却融进长竖形拖影。红花头仿佛悬在深色底部之上，纤细花茎在树木沉重的柔软团块下显得脆弱。整体幽静、略有异样，像熟悉的草地同时透过雨、雾和运动观看。
style_prompt_en: Atmospheric photographic abstraction with selective color and deliberate vertical motion blur. Let a few small warm accents remain recognizable against a mostly grayscale field, while large background forms dissolve into elongated soft streaks. Use misty high-key space above and a deep nearly black base below to make thin stems or other delicate lines emerge from darkness. Focus is uneven by design: one or two near details are legible, and farther textures fade into haze and grain. A strong dark silhouette on one side can balance a loose cluster of bright small forms on the other. Avoid crisp horizons and literal scenic depth; tonal gradients and blurred motion provide space. The result is quiet, fragile, and a little uncanny, with restraint in both color and subject detail.
style_prompt_zh: 大气感摄影抽象使用选择性色彩与刻意的竖向运动模糊。少数暖色小重点保持可辨，大部分灰阶背景形体则溶成长而软的拖影。上方使用雾状高调空间，下方压成近乎黑色的底，让细茎或其他精巧线条从黑暗中浮出。焦点有意不均：一两处近细节清楚，更远的纹理消退为霾和颗粒。一侧强暗剪影可平衡另一侧松散的亮色小形群。避免锐利地平线和字面的风景纵深，空间由灰阶渐变与模糊运动形成。结果安静、脆弱、略带异样，色彩和主题细节都受到节制。
theme_en: A dreamlike blurred meadow of red poppies and dark slender trees fading into gray mist
theme_zh: 梦境般失焦的草地上，红罂粟与纤细暗树渐渐隐入灰雾
name: Chris Friel
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
